notes: Jilan E-Khidmat v1.0: Punjab Government e-Khidmat Markaz helper — services guide (domicile, birth & death certificates, marriage certificate, land record / Fard, driving licence, character certificate, vehicle registration, NADRA & passport facilitation at selected centres), how-it-works guide and the official e-Khidmat portal (ekhidmat.punjab.gov.pk) inside the app. The app collects and saves nothing.
